GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 569.3 (23 Dec 45) GC
(SCAPIN - 488)
23 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Passenger Lists of Japanese Nationals Repatriated by Ships of the Allied Powers.
1. Reference is made to letter, Imperial Japanese Government, C. L. O. No 1250 (5.2), dated 20 December 1945, subject as above.
2. The military commanders of the areas from which Japanese are being repatriated have been requested to provide captains of Allied vessels, carrying Japanese repatriated to Japan, with separate passenger lists for military, naval and civilian repatriates.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
